## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: Migration Check block in exactly 7 skills: onboarding, brainstorm, sprint, preplanning, fix-bug, roadmap, debug-everything

## Implementation
Add migrate-design-notes-to-design-md.sh invocation to the Migration Check section of these 7 SKILL.md files:
1. plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md (NEW Migration Check block)
2. plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md (append to existing)
3. plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md (append to existing)
4. plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md (NEW Migration Check block)
5. plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md (append to existing)
6. plugins/dso/skills/roadmap/SKILL.md (append to existing)
7. plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md (append to existing)

Pattern: bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/migrate-design-notes-to-design-md.sh" 2>/dev/null || true

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass — Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Exactly 7 skill files reference the script — Verify: grep -rl 'migrate-design-notes-to-design-md' plugins/dso/skills/*/SKILL.md | wc -l | tr -d ' ' | grep -q '^7$'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
data.title: Add Migration Check blocks to 7 skill files
